title: Processing Budget Billing Plans
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

Processing Budget Billing Plans

When periodic billing documents are invoiced, a new budget billing plan is created automatically for contracts that were billed
periodically. The budget billing plan is based on the budget billing extrapolation lines, which are generated by the billing document.
A reference to the bill to be created is stored in the header of the budget billing plan in the Inv. doc. no. field (invoicing document
number), so that information about future budget billings is shown on the bill. For information about other options for grouping

budget billings of the different contracts of a budget billing plan, see the documentation for the Budget Billing Plan (IS-U-IN-BB)
component.

If budget billing plans relate to the billed period of a billing document, then they are processed in invoicing on the basis of the
billing procedure used.

Invoicing can consist of the following steps:

e Deactivate budget billing plan
The invoicing document number appears automatically in the budget billing plan header in the Deactivate field.
This means that:
o You cannot further process the budget billing plan.
o All budget billing plan items are deactivated.
o The budget billing amounts cannot be paid, dunned or requested.
e Deactivate budget billing plan items

Open items in the invoicing period are deactivated if the invoicing document number is set as the clearing document
number.

1   Note that the deactivated budget billing plan items:

o Cannot be further processed.

o Cannot be paid, dunned or requested.

e Settle the budget billing payments (statistical budget billing plan procedure) or budget billing receivables against the
amount invoiced for the contract (partial billing procedure).

On the basis of the selected budget billing procedure, budget billing payments or receivables that have been made, are
deducted from the billing document. (See Customizing for |}}SAP Utilities } Invoicing » Basic Settings » Define System

Settings for Invoicing 3).

o Budget billing payments which have been made and recorded as payments in contract accounts receivable and
payable, can be reposted into the total in invoicing. This is part of the statistical budget billing plan procedure.

As aresult the budget billing and the new business partner item budget billing reposting are cleared by a new
accounts receivable and payable document which is created in invoicing. The bill receivable of the invoicing
document is cleared against the budget billing payments.

o The bill receivable is reduced in invoicing by the budget billing amounts, which are set as debits in the partial billing
procedure.
